decisions.reason: Operator training builds directly on the firm's service capabilities, was presented on its own page in two consecutive years, costs little to carry, and supports machine sales, so results likely meet the aspiration.

A fourth-axis accessory complements the core milling systems and needs little extra resource, so in a growing industry with some slack the firm has little reason to drop it, even though it was only mentioned on the website.

Hybrid additive post-processing is distant from the core offer, was only mentioned rather than presented prominently, and probably falls short of the aspiration, which prompts problemistic search and redirection of its resources to the core business.
The high-speed CNC milling machine is close to the firm's core competence and was presented prominently, so it likely meets performance aspirations based on the firm's history and its peers.
The automatic tool change system strengthens the configurable machine portfolio, was presented on its own page, and fits the firm's modular engineering, so keeping it is the satisficing choice.
